site.description: LK-CORPORATE S.A.S.U. supports individuals, businesses and institutions in construction, civil engineering, public works, solar energy and logistics.

accueil.heroTexte: Civil engineering, public works, solar energy and logistics for individuals, businesses and institutions.
accueil.servicesTitre: Nine areas, a single point of contact
accueil.servicesTexte: From structural work to procurement, LK-CORPORATE covers a project end to end, without juggling several contractors.
accueil.valeursTitre: What our clients judge us on
accueil.valeursTexte: LK-CORPORATE works with individuals, businesses and institutions. Three standards apply to all of them.

valeurs.texte: Work carried out to professional standards, inspected at every stage of the site.
Commitments kept on deadlines, quantities and quoted prices.
One contact, reachable, who reports on progress without having to be chased.

accueil.realisationsVideTitre: The first projects will be published here
accueil.realisationsVideTexte: Each project is added from the admin area, with its before and after photos, description and location.
accueil.ctaTitre: A project, or a need for materials or transport?
accueil.ctaTexte: Describe your needs in a few lines, attach your documents or photos, and receive a costed proposal.

services.metaDescription: The nine areas LK-CORPORATE works in: civil engineering, renovation, public works, materials, solar energy, cleaning, logistics, land and general trade.
services.chapo: Building and civil engineering, supply, energy, cleaning and logistics. Each area can be commissioned on its own or combined with the others within a single project.
services.ctaTitre: Does your project span several areas?
services.ctaTexte: Describe your whole requirement in a single request. We will come back to you with a costed proposal.
services.besoinTexte: The form opens with this area already selected. You can attach your plans, photos or documents.
